name: cache-magic
description: Keeps a handoff while a large session's prompt cache is still warm. On a five-minute cache, a late prompt can go out after the handoff instead of the full context. On a one-hour cache the session stays, and compaction is pointed at the handoff.

enabled.title: Cache Magic: On
enabled.description: Cache Magic runs only in sessions over 50k tokens. While the prompt cache is still warm it spends one model call, mostly read from the cache, writing .claude/cache-magic/handoff.md. A five-minute cache can then send a late prompt after the handoff. A one-hour cache leaves the session alone

autoLoad.title: Cache Magic: Auto-load
autoLoad.description: What happens to a prompt you send after a five-minute cache expired, when a handoff is ready. The same choice applies to a one-hour cache only when idle compaction is off (idleCompaction or autoCompactEnabled set to false). ask-once: ask the first time and save your answer here as auto or ask. auto: clear the session and send the prompt after the handoff. ask: ask each time. off: send it with the full context

cacheTtlOverride.title: Cache Magic: Cache TTL fallback
cacheTtlOverride.description: Rarely needed: the mod reads the TTL the API applied from the session transcript. This is used only before the first response that wrote to the cache. auto follows CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, then the promptCacheTtl setting, then 5m

keep.title: Cache Magic: Handoff keeps
keep.description: Comma-separated parts the handoff holds: instructions (your messages, quoted), decisions (choices and failed attempts), files (paths, commands, and git status), next (the next step and open questions). Anything else keeps all four. The first large turn asks this in the answers row; the answer is recorded here on the next session

generator.title: Cache Magic: Handoff writer
generator.description: session: the session's own model writes it from its cached context, billed at the cache-read rate, seeing everything. haiku: Haiku writes it from a trimmed transcript, uncached and seeing only the newest ~100k tokens. Cheaper per token, less complete

timeoutSeconds.title: Cache Magic: Handoff timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the handoff before giving up and logging to .claude/cache-magic/handoff-error.log
